title: With an iPhone, switch off iMessages first
body_md: If an iPhone is used to prepare the card, the iMessages function must be deactivated before the four settings are made.
prev_context: Before this stands the four-step preparation of the card.
next_context: Section 2.2 on inserting the card into the module begins.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 13: equivalent in substance. Both versions tie the condition to the four steps; the step numbers are replaced by a reference to the list because the web version separates numbering from the order of operating steps.
